components.name: Agent Runtime
components.description: Managed execution environment for running AI agents on GPU-powered infrastructure. Handles orchestration, scaling, and lifecycle management for deployed agents.

components.name: Inference
components.description: Serverless access to foundation models (e.g. Llama, Mistral, GPT) via OpenAI-compatible API.

components.name: ADK
components.description: (Agent Development Kit) Open-source toolkit for building, testing, and deploying AI agents locally or in the cloud via CLI and SDK integrations.

components.name: Knowledge Bases
components.description: RAG-powered document stores that give agents access to your data. Supports multiple data sources for accurate, context-aware responses.

components.name: Guardrails
components.description: Content safety layer that filters agent inputs and outputs. Enforces topic restrictions and behavioral boundaries to keep agents on-task and compliant.

components.name: Model Services
components.description: Hosts and serves foundation and embedding models for serverless and dedicated inference workloads across the Gradient AI Platform.

incidents.name: Object Storage - SGP1 and SFO3
incidents.message:
As of 14:30 UTC, our Engineering team has resolved the issue impacting Spaces in our SGP1 and SFO3 regions. Users should no longer experience slowness or timeouts when trying to create or access their Spaces resources in the SGP1 and SFO3 regions. 

If you continue to experience problems, please open a ticket with our support team. We apologize for any inconvenience.

incidents.name: Network Connectivity in LON1
incidents.message:
As of 15:45 UTC, our Engineering team has confirmed the full resolution of the issue that impacted network reachability in the LON1 region. All services and resources should now be fully reachable.

If you continue to experience problems, please open a ticket with our support team from within your Cloud Control Panel. 

Thank you for your patience and we apologize for any inconvenience.

incidents.name: [Scheduled] Core Infrastructure Maintenance
incidents.message: The scheduled maintenance has been completed.

incidents.name: Networking in multiple regions.
incidents.message:
Our Engineering team has confirmed the full resolution of the issue impacting network connectivity in multiple regions. The impact has been completely subsided and the network connectivity is back to normal for all the impacted services.

Thank you for your patience and we apologize for any inconvenience.

incidents.name: App Platform Accessibility via Cloud
incidents.message:
As of 16:10 UTC, our Engineering team has confirmed the full resolution of the issue impacting our App platform service where users were not able to access their Apps via Cloud Panel. Apps should be loading fine https://cloud.digitalocean.com/apps without any errors. 

We appreciate your patience during the process and if you continue to experience any issues  please open a ticket with our support team.

incidents.name: Managed Database Cluster
incidents.message:
As of 06:25 UTC, our Engineering team has confirmed that the issue impacting the newly created Managed Database Clusters has been fully resolved. 

Users will no longer experience issues with the newly created Managed Database Cluster.

If you continue to experience any issues with Managed Database Clusters please open a ticket with our support team. Thank you for your patience.

incidents.name: DigitalOcean Control Panel and API
incidents.message:
From 22:45 to 23:00 UTC, our Engineering team has reported an issue with DigitalOcean Control Panel and API.
 
During that time, Customers may have experienced intermittent timeout errors while using DigitalOcean Control Panel and API. 

If you continue to experience problems, please open a ticket with our support team. Thank you for your patience and we apologize for any inconvenience.

incidents.name: Network Latency in SFO Region
incidents.message: Our Engineering team has confirmed the full resolution of the networking issue in the SFO regions. If you continue to see issues with latency or packet loss in the SFO region please reach out directly to our support team for assistance.

incidents.name: Spaces CDN in Multiple Regions
incidents.message:
Our Engineering team has confirmed the resolution of the issue that impacted the Spaces CDN. Objects should be accessible over the CDN endpoint without any issues. However, HTTP/2 is temporarily unavailable due to upstream issues, and due to this HTTP/2 requests should automatically be re-negotiated to 1.1, but in case you experience failures please open a ticket with our support team.

Thank you for your patience and we apologize for any inconvenience.

incidents.name: Managed Kubernetes Service
incidents.message:
Our Engineering team has resolved the issue with the Managed Kubernetes Service. A daemonset has been released to all existing clusters eliminating the auto-update process and it will be removed again going forward. If you find worker nodes that could still be affected by a prior occurrence of this incident, please replace them for permanent mitigation.

If you continue to experience problems, please open a ticket with our support team. We apologize for any inconvenience.

incidents.name: CDN Insights for App Platform
incidents.message:
From 14:44 UTC to 18:04 UTC we experienced another issue with our App Platform service related to CDN Insights for Apps in all regions. During this window, users might have observed blank graphs or no data for the CDN metrics including request counts, cache hit rates etc. Our engineering team was able to identify the problem and resolve it fully and as of 18:04 UTC all the metrics are displaying properly. 

The connectivity issue with the Apps for which we updated the status page earlier was only faced by a subset of users in FRA1 region, only between 12:45 UTC to 14:15 UTC. The normal functionality of apps was entirely restored around 14:15 UTC.

Thank you for your patience on this and if you continue to face issues then please open a support ticket from within the cloud control panel.

incidents.name: App Platform in FRA1
incidents.message:
Between 12:45 UTC and 14:15 UTC, we experienced an issue impacting the App platform apps in the FRA1 region. During this time, a subset of users might have experienced degraded performance or errors while accessing their apps in the region.

Our engineering team was able to take quick action to mitigate the impact and resolve the issue, and as of 14:15 UTC all services are now functioning normally. Thank you for your patience, and we apologize for any inconvenience. 

If you continue to experience any issues, please open a Support ticket right away for further review.

incidents.name: Spaces in SGP1
incidents.message:
Our engineering team has resolved the issue impacting Spaces in our SGP1 region. From approximately 11:47 UTC - 13:35 UTC, users may have encountered errors with API or object requests, experienced difficulties in creating new buckets in SGP1, or faced issues with loading Spaces in the Cloud Control Panel. Spaces should now be operating normally. 

If you continue to experience problems, please open a ticket with our support team. Thank you for your patience and we apologize for any inconvenience.

incidents.name: Network Connectivity in NYC region
incidents.message:
From 04:30 - 05:10 UTC, our Engineering team observed an issue with network connectivity in the NYC region. During this time, users might have experienced high latency or errors while connecting to services, including Droplets and Droplet-based products like Managed Kubernetes, Managed Database, and App Platform Apps. 

As of 05:10 UTC, the impact has been subsided and users should no longer be facing network connectivity issues. We apologize for the inconvenience and if you are still experiencing issues or have any additional questions then please open a support ticket from within your account.

incidents.name: Subsea Fiber Faults
incidents.message:
Our Engineering team has observed stability for network routes and App Platform builds and deployments over the last week. Given this, we will proceed with closing out this incident. 

If the situation changes or we receive any important updates regarding the repair of the fiber faults, we will communicate as needed. 

If you are still experiencing any issues or have any questions, please feel free to open a support ticket from within your account. Thank you for your patience.

incidents.name: DigitalOcean Docs (https://docs.digitalocean.com) Unavailable
incidents.message:
Our Engineering team identified an issue with the DigitalOcean Docs site (https://docs.digitalocean.com), resulting in all users attempting to view the main site or any docs pages seeing 500 errors. 

Beginning around 16:55 UTC, the Docs site became unavailable following a complication with a deploy. At 17:16, our Engineering team triggered a new deploy and the site came back online. 

We apologize for the disruption. If you have any questions or concerns, please reach out through a Support ticket from within your account.

If you continue to experience problems, please open a ticket with our support team from your Cloud Control Panel.

Our Engineering team was able to issue a new token and rolled out the change regionally in order to not disrupt multiple data planes at once. 

This issue is fully resolved. If you continue to experience problems, please open a ticket with our Support team. Thank you for your patience and we apologize for the inconvenience.
